name: Canva Magic Studio
summary: Canva Magic Studio is Canva's set of tools for images, layouts, and short copy. A business user can make a slide, a social post, or a one-page brief.
paragraphs: Canva Magic Studio is Canva's set of tools for images, layouts, and short copy. A business user can make a slide, a social post, or a one-page brief.
whyItMatters: Use it to produce a first visual, then check that the words and the facts are yours.
